sceneConcept: A tall athletic thirty-eight-year-old Chinese old-city security commander stands alone against a transparent background with disciplined stillness. A short black undercut, brown eyes and a stern composed face reflect her former-military precision. She wears a completely plain matte-navy patrol uniform beneath fitted black body armor, black gloves, a practical utility belt, straight tactical trousers and heavy boots. Standing squarely, she holds one open gloved hand vertically beside her shoulder, palm facing forward with exactly five fingers held close together in a precise halt gesture; her other arm rests at her side. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the armor surfaces subdued. Visual refresh: modular matte armor with contrasting straps and a compact command interface.
